name: Global and U.S. News
description: The day's significant news, worldwide and in the United States, as surfaced by the New York Times and the Economist, organized by the Economist's sections, with the top two or three stories in each, summarized and linked.
cadence: daily, run at 05:05 America/New_York (09:05 UTC in daylight time)
edition_size: 2 to 3 stories per category unless the category sets max_stories; a category with nothing significant is omitted
category_notes: Weights are all 1.0 at launch. They exist so that personal signals and a later private view can reweight them without changing the profile's shape.
'The world this week' is read as agenda only; it is a digest, not a category.

Every candidate, from either agenda source or from discovery, is assigned to exactly one category by the agent. NYT feeds map naturally: World to the regional categories, U.S. and Politics to United States, Business to Business or Finance and economics.
deprioritize: sports, except an event of national or international consequence
individual crime stories without systemic significance
opinion and commentary, unless the edition is explicitly surfacing a leader
live-blog and 'what we know' rolling formats

agenda_sources.window_note: The Economist publishes its weekly edition on Thursday and Friday and only a few items on other days, so a 48-hour window misses most of it after Saturday. Seven days makes the whole current issue agenda; the archive prevents repeats.

coverage.discovery_note: Retired 2026-10-18 in favour of signal feeds and the per-source tally on the cuts page.

editorial.summary_rule: original prose, written from coverage the agent read; no verbatim passages beyond a short attributed quote

category_scope_notes.finance-and-economics: Give room to the financing of the AI build-out: debt loads at AI infrastructure companies, bond and credit-default-swap moves, hyperscaler capital spending, and the market's exposure to it. Owner's standing interest, 2026-10-17.
category_scope_notes.business: Same emphasis as Finance and economics on the AI build-out and its risks, from the company side: capex, contracts, concentration, and who bears the losses if demand slows.

source_roles.agenda: Sets what is significant today. The editor ranks from these desks' judgment.
source_roles.signal: Corroborates and widens the aperture. Items are candidates like any other, judged on consequence; a story only these feeds surfaced is the measure of what the agenda missed. Added 2026-10-18 to replace web-search discovery, after AP, Reuters and the BBC proved unreachable to the search tool. AP and Reuters publish no usable feed.
